## Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for corporate gifts?+

Our minimum order quantity varies by product category. Generally, it ranges from 25-100 pieces for most items. Contact us for specific MOQ requirements for your chosen products.

Do you offer custom branding and logo printing?+

Yes! We offer various customization options including logo printing, engraving, embossing, and embroidery. Our design team can help you create the perfect branded corporate gifts.

What are your delivery timelines across India?+

Standard delivery takes 7-10 business days for metro cities and 10-15 days for other locations. Express delivery options are available for urgent orders with additional charges.

Can I get samples before placing a bulk order?+

Absolutely! We provide samples for most products. Sample charges are applicable and will be adjusted against your final order value for orders above our minimum quantity.

What is a joining kit and what does it include?+

A joining kit is a welcome package for new employees containing essential items like notebooks, pens, company merchandise, and branded accessories. Our joining kit boxes can be customized with your company logo and include items like premium polo shirts, executive bags, customized flask bottles, and corporate stationery.

Do you manufacture Zoha bags and embroidered laptop bags?+

Yes! Zoha bags are our specialty. We manufacture executive bags, embroidered laptop bags, custom embroidered laptop bags, massage backpacks, and premium personalized bags with embroidery. All our bags can be customized with company logos and are perfect for corporate gifting.

What corporate gifts do you offer for Doctor's Day 2025?+

For Doctor's Day 2025 (July 1st), we offer specialized promotional gifts for doctors including customized flask bottles, premium polo shirts, executive laptop bags, personalized A5 notebooks, and wellness kits. Our doctor's day gifts are designed to show appreciation for medical professionals.

Are you among the top corporate gifting companies in Hyderabad?+

Yes, Zoha is recognized as one of the top corporate gifting companies in Hyderabad. We are leading corporate gifts manufacturers and suppliers in Hyderabad, offering comprehensive corporate gifting solutions for businesses across Andhra Pradesh and India.

Do you provide ecommerce delivery bags and shipping solutions?+

Yes, we manufacture ecommerce delivery bags, courier delivery bags, food delivery bags, and shipping e-commerce bags. Our delivery bags are durable, customizable, and perfect for businesses needing reliable packaging solutions for their delivery operations.

What customization options do you offer for corporate gifts?+

We offer extensive customization including logo embroidery, printing, engraving, and personalization. Our services include customized flask bottles, corporate gift bags with logo, embroidered polo shirts for business, custom A5 notebooks, personalized bags with embroidery, and customized school bags with logo.

Do you offer festive corporate gifting for Diwali and other occasions?+

Absolutely! We specialize in festive corporate gifting including Zenith Diwali hampers, Zenith Diwali gifts, luxury Diwali presents, and eco-friendly Diwali corporate gifts. Our festive gift hampers are perfect for celebrating occasions with employees and clients.

What premium products do you offer for corporate gifting?+

Our premium range includes executive laptop bags, premium polo shirts, premium business products set, signature gift sets, premium diary for gifts, sophisticated gifts, and distinctive gifts. We also offer premium polo t-shirts, luxury corporate gift sets, and bespoke corporate presents.

Do you provide corporate gifting solutions for pharma companies and HR departments?+

Yes, we specialize in corporate gifting for pharma companies and corporate gifting solutions for HR departments. Our services include employee onboarding kits, bulk employee gifting, digital corporate gift solutions with no logistics hassles, and customized corporate gifting programs.

What types of bags do you manufacture besides corporate gifts?+
